name: translucent_sort
describe: Painter's-order translucent sort: for each quad (4 verts, BLOCK format 7 ints/vertex) compute centroid-to-camera squared distance via getDistanceSq, then stable-sort quad indices by DESCENDING distance (Floats.compare == Float.compare; Arrays.sort on Integer[] is stable TimSort -> ties keep ascending original index). Output the permutation. Bit-exact float distance + deterministic tie order.
